insights.summary: When Genesys transfers a call between queues or agents, the PreSense screen pop arrives blank for the receiving agent.
insights.quote: When Genesys transfers a call between queues or between agents, the PreSense screen pop shows up blank for whoever receives it.

insights.summary: When the AI Voice Agent transfers to a live agent, the details it collected do not arrive, so callers repeat themselves.
insights.quote: When the AI Voice Agent transfers to a live agent, none of the details it collected come over with the call.

insights.summary: The Salesforce integration stops writing call data to custom objects when fields or picklist values change.
insights.quote: Our Salesforce integration has been dropping call data, but only on custom objects.
